messages:
sophie: Noticing a throughput dip on llama3-13b in prod after the rope_theta default change. CPU on host rising, p99 tail latency spikes. Anyone else?

michael: Saw that. Correlates with kernel-selector flip to `latency-first` in last deploy. Perf graphs show repeated KV eviction + reload loops.

ranjit: Can you paste a flame/profile? Also which chattemplate variant was used (system-first vs inline)?

sophie: Snippet from the profiler: ```perf: pid=1234 hotloops=KV::reload (sampling 2000ms) copyBytes=+1.2GB/s context_switches++``` Running chattemplate=system-first with long prefix (~400 tokens).

infra-bot: nightly-deploy 2026-03-15T03:12Z -> rolled kernel-selector=latency-first, rope_theta=1.5 (default) :rocket:

kevin: Hypothesis: `latency-first` prefers smaller attention kernels that don't keep KV in-gpu-resident, causing more host<->GPU memcpy when sequence patterns are ragged. Also batch-slicer backpressure is shrinking effective batch sizes -> worse KV locality.

olivia: I reproduced locally with seq mix (p80 short / p20 long). GPU-side profile: ```cudaMemcpy: 40% wall time in hot path when KV size ~1.6GB``` - matches the eviction/reload story.

michael: Possible quick mitigations: 1) force kernel-selector override -> `throughput-prefer` for models with hidden_size>=8192 or head_dim>=128, 2) smooth rope_theta ramp so selector doesn't flip mid-session, 3) bias batch_slicer to keep slightly larger windows for chattemplate=system-first.

sophie: Experiment plan:
  1) Pin kernel_selector=throughput-prefer on 5 canary hosts running llama3-13b.
  2) Increase batch_slicer window from 8->16 for canary.
  3) Add `kv-keepalive` hint to prevent eviction on short idle gaps.
  4) A/B test system-first vs inline chattemplate for latency/throughput.

ranjit: Add metric: `kv_evictions_per_request` and tag by `model`, `chattemplate`, and `kernel_selector`. I'll wire a dashboard tile. :eyes:

olivia: Small patch ready: `runtime/heuristics/kv_policy.cc` - changed default evict_threshold from `0.25` -> `0.10` for long-prefix templates. Pushed PR #4029.

kevin: PR looks reasonable. Please add a unit that simulates mixed-sequence workload so we don't regress for other models. Also add a canary rollout policy.

sophie: Nice. If kernels still flip, we'll prototype a compact KV header kept on host to avoid full memcpy for short-prefix reuse (only copy diffs).

michael: One more finding: fused RMSNorm+SiLU kernel gives ~6% throughput boost but slightly changes intermediate layout; ensure kernel-selector considers fused-operator memory footprint when scoring kernels.

sophie: TL;DR action items: pin selector on canary, add kv_evictions metric + dashboard, merge PR with unit, prototype micro-kv-header, and validate fused-kernel footprints. I'll coordinate the canary rollout tomorrow morning. :+1:
